plan.title: Proof and reflection in one voice note, then an engaged tester: real follow-ups, a natural wrap-up once ZOH has real insight

context.text: Chapter 4 tonight, Maya: 8 pm on the couch, about 20 minutes. Then a quick voice recap.

transcript.text: [voice: Okay, finished chapter four. Honestly the habit stacking idea clicked, like linking a new habit to one you already do. The hard part was my phone kept buzzing the whole time.]

Chapter 4 done, Maya, that's 4 days in a row. LFG 📚 Habit stacking is a great one to land on. Where do you see yourself stacking your reading onto something you already do every day, since the buzzing phone kept pulling you out?
yeah like after I do the dishes I could just sit down and read

Dishes, then couch, then Atomic Habits. That's habit stacking in action, Maya. Your phone buzzing was the hard part tonight, so what's one thing you could do with it when you sit down, so it stops pulling you out?
the buzzing is mostly work slack, even at night

That makes sense, Maya. Work Slack at night is a tough one to ignore. So for tomorrow, let's build on what clicked: chapter 5 on the couch at 8 pm (about 20 min), right after the dishes. Before you sit down, pause Slack or turn on Do Not Disturb for those 20 minutes. Then send a voice recap like today. Work for you?
I could leave it charging in the kitchen I guess

That's even better than Do Not Disturb, Maya, because out of reach means out of mind. Tomorrow: dishes, phone on the charger in the kitchen, then chapter 5 on the couch at 8. Grab your phone after for the voice recap. You've got this 💪
oh and the sticky note thing from the chapter, I actually wrote one: after the dishes I read on the couch
Maya, you actually wrote the sticky note! That takes the chapter off the page and puts it in your kitchen. 📝 Where did you stick it, so you'll see it right after the dishes?
Perfect, Maya. Tomorrow's set: dishes, phone on the charger, then chapter 5 on the couch at 8. Good work today 🙌

grade.summary: ZOH handled the first voice note well: it counted and celebrated the proof, followed up on habit stacking, the buzzing phone and the sticky note one question at a time, then proposed a fully defined chapter 5 step built on the charger cue. After 'ok that works' it confirmed in one line with no new question, meeting the regression case, with the gap-on-reading question only covered indirectly.
